info.title: sparkplug-agent ingest API
info.summary: HTTP raw-tag front door of the sparkplug-agent (ADR-0042 Mode A).
info.description:
A connectivity plane (a client's Node-RED tee or the Go PLC readers) POSTs plain-JSON raw-tag envelopes here; the agent resolves them against the tenant's tag map, assigns SparkPlug aliases and publishes SparkPlug B upstream. Served by the `sparkplug-agent` binary on its ingest listener (AGENT_INGEST_PORT, default 9104, plaintext HTTP) when AGENT_HTTP_INGEST_ENABLED=true. `/healthz` and `/metrics` live on the agent's separate health listener (HEALTH_PORT).

Two modes, fixed at start-up:
- Single-tenant (`--config <client.yaml>`): an envelope that declares a different group is 403; an envelope with no group is accepted. `X-Ingest-Group` is ignored. `POST /v1/counters` exists only in this mode and only when AGENT_NUMERIC_INGEST_ENABLED=true (404 otherwise).
- Multi-tenant (AGENT_TENANTS_DIR, e.g. `sparkplug-agent-shared`): the group is mandatory. The body's `group`/`group_id`/`tenant` wins, else the `X-Ingest-Group` header, else 403; an unknown group is 403.

Public hosts (staging only; the agent is not deployed by the production compose file):
- `https://ingest.staging.packiot.app:8449/v1/tags` -> sparkplug-agent-shared. Exact path only; the security group admits 8449 from registered box egress addresses only.
- `https://cpack-ingest.staging.packiot.app:8447/v2/tags` -> sparkplug-agent-shared `/v1/tags`, with nginx injecting `X-Ingest-Group: CPACK`. `/v1/tags` on that host is closed (444). Port 8447 is admitted for CPACK's egress address only.
Neither public host proxies `/v1/counters` or `/openapi.json`.

On-prem edge boxes run the same agent with the listener published on the box loopback (127.0.0.1:9104).

servers.description: Staging shared multi-tenant public front door (nginx exact-path /v1/tags only; source-IP allowlisted)
Staging in-network (packiot-net alias edge-agent-shared, static IP 172.18.0.44:9104)
On-prem edge box loopback / local development

post.description: Order of checks: `X-Ingest-Key` (401) -> body read under AGENT_INGEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB; over the cap, unreadable or empty -> 400) -> tenant routing / scope (403) -> envelope decode (400) -> optional PLC link report recorded -> tags fed to the tenant pipeline. Tags whose suffix is not in the tenant's tag map are dropped and counted, not rejected, so `accepted` may be lower than `total`. An empty `tags` list is valid (heartbeat, or a failed PLC read reported through `link`).

accepted.description: Tags that resolved to a mapped metric.

400.description: `payload too large`, `cannot read body`, `empty body`, or `undecodable envelope` (malformed JSON, a tag with an empty `metric`, or a non-scalar `value`).

post.summary: Ingest a legacy numeric counter envelope (ADR-0045 option B)
post.description: Single-tenant agents with AGENT_NUMERIC_INGEST_ENABLED=true only; otherwise this path is not mounted (404). Accepts the legacy `counterData: [{id, value}]` shape (flat, or nested per endpoint under `counters`), translates each numeric count index to a canonical tag through the tenant's count-index table, and feeds the same pipeline as `/v1/tags`. Unknown count ids are counted (`unmapped_index`), not rejected. A declared group other than the agent's scope is 403.

unmapped_index.description: Counter ids with no canonical metric.

400.description: `payload too large`, `cannot read body`, `empty body`, or `undecodable counter envelope`.

ingestKey.name: X-Ingest-Key
ingestKey.description: Shared ingest key (AGENT_INGEST_API_KEY), compared in constant time. The agent refuses to start the listener without a key. Never logged.

IngestGroup.name: X-Ingest-Group
IngestGroup.description: Multi-tenant mode only: routing key used when the body carries no `group`/`group_id`/`tenant`. Case-insensitive. A per-tenant nginx front door sets it (cpack-ingest injects `CPACK`). Ignored in single-tenant mode.

Forbidden.description: Tenant routing/scope rejection: `out-of-scope group` (single-tenant), `missing group (...)` or `unknown group` (multi-tenant).

RawTagEnvelope.description: Tier-1 raw-tag envelope (ADR-0042 section 2.3). Tag names are metric SUFFIXES; the agent prepends the equipment's packml_topic. Unknown fields are ignored.

group.description: Tenant SparkPlug group. `group_id` and `tenant` are accepted as aliases (first non-empty wins).

endpoint.description: Connectivity endpoint/device the readings came from.

scan_ts.description: Scan time, unix milliseconds; default for tags without `ts`.

value.description: Scalar reading. The SparkPlug datatype comes from the tag map, not from this JSON type.

param.description: PackML parameter id carried by an id-bearing Parameter metric (e.g. 30701); 0 or absent means none.

link.description: Optional PLC connection report for this scan. Recorded only when `endpoint` and a positive `scan_ts` are present and the request passed auth and routing.

ok.description: true when the scan connected to and read the PLC.

CounterEnvelope.description: Legacy numeric counter body. Both `counterData` and nested `counters[].counterData` are flattened into one list. Unknown fields are ignored.

group.description: Checked against the agent's scope when present (`group_id`/`tenant` are aliases).

gateway.description: Used as the endpoint when `endpoint` is empty.
